notes.title: How to deal with black screen/stuttering in games
notes.notes:
Since the video is shot with 8K resolution, if you encounter video stuttering/black screen during the game, you may need to install the "HEVC Video Extension" to experience it normally. It is recommended to install the plug-in and then restart the program.
Please note: "HEVC Video Extension" comes with the win11 system, and non-win11 systems need to download this plug-in from the Microsoft Store.
